eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 11:34 AM on AUG 25, 2021 Effective until 9:34 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for the Phoenix Police Department.  This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety.  Phoenix Police are looking for a female by the name of Wilma Condor. She is 5'8" tall, 130 pounds with blue eyes and gray hair. She was last seen on foot in the area of Central Avenue and Glendale Avenue. She was wearing a blue jean jacket, black shirt, blue jean pants, and glasses. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
